items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: She started me on piano when I was 6 or 7 for about 2 years -- she was a wonderful teacher.

ctx.x: I've met this lady, I'm proud to say.

Yeah, she's 91 and very alert. And she took an interest in me in the family, living there with my grandfolks. She started me on piano when I was 6 or 7 for about 2 years -- she was a wonderful teacher. And I
didn't go very far from there, but I did it. I did gain some musical knowledge by fooling around myself.
